status: UNVALIDATED reference-guided rule proposals: thresholds & subfamily calls require benchmark calibration; no homology implies adhesome recruitment.
scope: Hierarchical homology annotation for comparative adhesome candidate screening

model_requirements.orthology_rule: Shared HOG is homology not orthology or paralog identity. Reciprocal lineage resolution required for specific calls.
model_requirements.benchmark_rule: No E-values, bit score deltas, margin thresholds, or confidence grades are validated by this JSON. Calibrate per clade via held-out phylogenetic references and outgroups.
model_requirements.function_rule: Protein identity and confirmed physical adhesome membership must be recorded separately.
model_requirements.topology_rule: SignalP/DeepTMHMM parsed cautiously; secretion/TM can contradict intracellular scaffold identity and support ECM/receptor cases; not proof alone.

integrin_alpha.classification_note: Variable detectable FG-GAP counts; alpha-specific stalk models recover divergent receptors. An alpha-I/VWA domain is optional, not required. No vertebrate alpha-subtype assignment.
integrin_alpha.label: integrin_alpha

fibronectin_III_ligand.classification_note: Legacy generic FNIII screening bucket, not a fibronectin-family assignment; reference FN1 moved explicitly to fibronectin_like in v4.
fibronectin_III_ligand.label: fibronectin_III_ligand

kindlin.classification_note: Kindlin-specific N-terminal model plus FERM/PH; PH insertion can interrupt FERM detection; generic FERM plus PH alone is insufficient.
kindlin.label: kindlin

actin.classification_note: Legacy name: do not classify as conventional actin from PF00022; evaluate actin_conventional versus ARP1-11.
actin.label: actin

cofilin.classification_note: Legacy name: PF00241 screens all ADF-H homologs; cannot diagnose CFL/ADF.
cofilin.label: cofilin

paxillin_like.classification_note: Legacy 3-LIM ambiguous screen; use PF03535/LD and reference sequence to assess paxillin family.
paxillin_like.label: paxillin_like

zyxin_like.classification_note: Legacy 3-LIM ambiguous screen; require specific reference evidence and negative controls.
zyxin_like.label: zyxin_like

FAK.classification_note: FAK-family includes PTK2/PTK2B/kin-32 relatives, including inactive kinases; PF03623 is focal adhesion targeting. PF02259 is PIKK FAT, not FAK. Human Y397 is not a transferable position.
FAK.label: FAK

Src.classification_note: Legacy name: generic SH3-SH2-TK screen, not an SFK assignment.
Src.label: Src

ILK.classification_note: ILK/pseudokinase: PF12796 Ank_2 plus kinase-like PF07714/PF00069, or legacy PF00023 repeats plus kinase. Alternative ankyrin HMMs are not additive repeat counts; catalytic activity is not required. Reciprocal evidence is needed.
ILK.label: ILK

PTP_PEST.classification_note: PTPN12/PTPN18/PTPN22-related PEST group, not one-to-one orthology. Requires reciprocal similarity extending at least 60 residues beyond catalytic-domain end or independent phylogeny; generic PxxP/PEST composition is not diagnostic.
PTP_PEST.label: PTP_PEST

LAR_RPTP.classification_note: LAR/type-IIa receptor PTP group (PTPRF/PTPRD/PTPRS); truncated relatives may be recovered by homology
LAR_RPTP.label: LAR_RPTP

RPTP_alpha_epsilon.classification_note: PTPRA/PTPRE/type-IV group; membrane topology is isoform dependent
RPTP_alpha_epsilon.label: RPTP_alpha_epsilon

generic_kinase_screen.classification_note: Generic catalytic-domain bucket; not an orthologous family or adhesion assignment
generic_kinase_screen.label: generic_kinase_screen

generic_PTP_screen.classification_note: Generic catalytic-domain bucket; not an orthologous family or adhesion assignment
generic_PTP_screen.label: generic_PTP_screen

fibronectin_like.classification_note: FN1/FN2/FN3 combination; counts need not match vertebrate FN1. Isolated repeat types are nonspecific. Partial architectures remain hypotheses unless independently resolved; no integrin-binding claim.
fibronectin_like.label: fibronectin_like

vitronectin_like.classification_note: Somatomedin-B followed by hemopexin-like region plus reciprocal family evidence. SMB occurs in ENPPs and hemopexin in proteases/HPX; neither alone assigns vitronectin.
vitronectin_like.label: vitronectin_like

generic_ECM_domain_screen.classification_note: Generic FN1/FN2/SMB/hemopexin domain bucket; extracellular location and adhesome membership are not inferred from a domain alone.
generic_ECM_domain_screen.label: generic_ECM_domain_screen

Syk.classification_note: Syk/ZAP70 family, not a one-to-one SYK orthology call. Tandem SH2 before kinase plus reciprocal family evidence; incomplete sequences stay provisional.
Syk.label: Syk

Csk.classification_note: CSK/MATK family. Shares SH3-SH2-kinase architecture with Src; reciprocal competition is essential. No Csk-specific motif or catalytic activity is inferred.
Csk.label: Csk

Nck.classification_note: NCK1/NCK2/dock family. Usually three SH3 domains before SH2; two detected SH3 are an allowed comparative alternative because NCK2 has an SH3_9 call outside the current HMM panel. No vertebrate paralogue assignment.
Nck.label: Nck

Grb2.classification_note: GRB2/drk family architecture; reciprocal evidence required. Shared architectures cannot resolve vertebrate paralogues.
Grb2.label: Grb2

Crk.classification_note: CRK/CRKL family. SH2 before SH3 permits CRK-I and SH3_2 domains not represented in the current panel; reciprocal family evidence required.
Crk.label: Crk

Shc.classification_note: SHC1/2/3/4 family. PTB/PID before SH2 with reciprocal family evidence; no phosphosite or vertebrate paralogue assignment.
Shc.label: Shc

actin_superfamily_screen.classification_note: Actin-fold screening only; conventional actins and Arps share PF00022.
actin_superfamily_screen.label: actin_superfamily_screen

actin_conventional.classification_note: Conventional actin; do not interpret PF00022 as distinguishing from ARPs. Cytoplasmic/muscle paralog names require species-resolved phylogeny.
actin_conventional.label: actin_conventional

ARP1.classification_note: Actin-related protein subfamily 1; conserved fold is insufficient; require reference-profile competition/phylogeny. Some Arps are primarily nuclear and not adhesion-specific.
ARP1.label: ARP1

ARP2.classification_note: Actin-related protein subfamily 2; conserved fold is insufficient; require reference-profile competition/phylogeny. Some Arps are primarily nuclear and not adhesion-specific.
ARP2.label: ARP2

ARP3.label: ARP3

ARP4.label: ARP4

ARP5.label: ARP5

ARP6.classification_note: Actin-related protein subfamily 6; conserved fold is insufficient; require reference-profile competition/phylogeny. Some Arps are primarily nuclear and not adhesion-specific.
ARP6.label: ARP6

ARP7.classification_note: Actin-related protein subfamily 7; conserved fold is insufficient; require reference-profile competition/phylogeny. Some Arps are primarily nuclear and not adhesion-specific.
ARP7.label: ARP7

ARP8.classification_note: Actin-related protein subfamily 8; conserved fold is insufficient; require reference-profile competition/phylogeny. Some Arps are primarily nuclear and not adhesion-specific.
ARP8.label: ARP8

ARP9.classification_note: Actin-related protein subfamily 9; conserved fold is insufficient; require reference-profile competition/phylogeny. Some Arps are primarily nuclear and not adhesion-specific.
ARP9.label: ARP9

ARP10.classification_note: Actin-related protein subfamily 10; conserved fold is insufficient; require reference-profile competition/phylogeny. Some Arps are primarily nuclear and not adhesion-specific.
ARP10.label: ARP10

ARP11.classification_note: Actin-related protein subfamily 11; conserved fold is insufficient; require reference-profile competition/phylogeny. Some Arps are primarily nuclear and not adhesion-specific.
ARP11.label: ARP11

ADF_H_screen.classification_note: ADF-H homology screening: cofilin, twinfilin, drebrin/Abp1 and GMF-like proteins require separation.
ADF_H_screen.label: ADF_H_screen

ADF_cofilin.classification_note: Single ADF-H class; identical domain count occurs in other ADF-H groups.
ADF_cofilin.label: ADF_cofilin

twinfilin.classification_note: Two tandem ADF-H domains; one-domain truncations should remain provisional rather than be called cofilin.
twinfilin.label: twinfilin

drebrin_Abp1.classification_note: Drebrin/Abp1 group; SH3 is present in some members but not all; do not require SH3. Compete with cofilin and GMF.
drebrin_Abp1.label: drebrin_Abp1

GMF.classification_note: Divergent ADF-H/glia maturation factor branch; Pfam absence possible; allow curated/profile partial recovery, not motif-only assignment.
GMF.label: GMF

coactosin.classification_note: ADF-H homolog related to drebrin group; do not relabel as cofilin automatically.
coactosin.label: coactosin

LIM_scaffold_screen.classification_note: LIM zinc fingers are highly promiscuous; nuclear LIM-only/homeodomain/PDLIM proteins are adversarial negatives.
LIM_scaffold_screen.label: LIM_scaffold_screen

PINCH_like.classification_note: Five LIM domains characteristic of PINCH; must distinguish other multi-LIM proteins and verify family profile; four detected LIMs plus identity may be fragment.
PINCH_like.label: PINCH_like

paxillin_family.classification_note: Paxillin-type N-terminal LD/PF03535 plus C-terminal LIMs; four LIM domains often expected; CDD paxillin LIM models helpful but must not distinguish PXN/LPXN/TGFB1I1 by themselves.
paxillin_family.label: paxillin_family

PXN.classification_note: PXN: requires paralog-resolving reference evidence; generic paxillin LIM or LD architecture does not discriminate.
PXN.label: PXN

LPXN.classification_note: LPXN: requires paralog-resolving reference evidence; generic paxillin LIM or LD architecture does not discriminate.
LPXN.label: LPXN

TGFB1I1.classification_note: TGFB1I1: requires paralog-resolving reference evidence; generic paxillin LIM or LD architecture does not discriminate.
TGFB1I1.label: TGFB1I1

zyxin_family.classification_note: Three C-terminal LIM domains and variable proline-rich N-terminus; architecture alone overlaps many LIM proteins.
zyxin_family.label: zyxin_family

ZYX.classification_note: ZYX; branch=zyxin_core. Triplicate LIM arrangement cannot distinguish these paralogous proteins; reference-based phylogeny is mandatory.
ZYX.label: ZYX

LPP.classification_note: LPP; branch=zyxin_core. Triplicate LIM arrangement cannot distinguish these paralogous proteins; reference-based phylogeny is mandatory.
LPP.label: LPP

TRIP6.classification_note: TRIP6; branch=zyxin_core. Triplicate LIM arrangement cannot distinguish these paralogous proteins; reference-based phylogeny is mandatory.
TRIP6.label: TRIP6

AJUBA.classification_note: AJUBA; branch=ajuba. Triplicate LIM arrangement cannot distinguish these paralogous proteins; reference-based phylogeny is mandatory.
AJUBA.label: AJUBA

LIMD1.classification_note: LIMD1; branch=ajuba. Triplicate LIM arrangement cannot distinguish these paralogous proteins; reference-based phylogeny is mandatory.
LIMD1.label: LIMD1

WTIP.classification_note: WTIP; branch=ajuba. Triplicate LIM arrangement cannot distinguish these paralogous proteins; reference-based phylogeny is mandatory.
WTIP.label: WTIP

FBLIM1.classification_note: FBLIM1; branch=FBLIM1. Triplicate LIM arrangement cannot distinguish these paralogous proteins; reference-based phylogeny is mandatory.
FBLIM1.label: FBLIM1

PDLIM_family.classification_note: PDZ (PF00595), followed by LIM (PF00412); PF00307 is calponin homology and is not a PDZ anchor. Important competitor for zyxin/PINCH.
PDLIM_family.label: PDLIM_family

LHX_LIM_homeobox_screen.classification_note: Two LIM + homeodomain transcription factors; negative class for adhesion LIM scaffolds.
LHX_LIM_homeobox_screen.label: LHX_LIM_homeobox_screen

FHL_screen.classification_note: Four-and-a-half LIM proteins; repeated LIM does not imply PINCH.
FHL_screen.label: FHL_screen

Src_family.classification_note: Src-family tyrosine kinases with SH4 membrane-anchor region and typical regulatory tail; other kinase families share SH3-SH2-TK. Myristoylation and tail Tyr are not standalone identification tests.
Src_family.label: Src_family

SRC.classification_note: SRC Src paralog; require split-aware phylogeny/RBH against other Src paralogs.
SRC.label: SRC

FYN.classification_note: FYN Src paralog; require split-aware phylogeny/RBH against other Src paralogs.
FYN.label: FYN

YES1.classification_note: YES1 Src paralog; require split-aware phylogeny/RBH against other Src paralogs.
YES1.label: YES1

LYN.classification_note: LYN Src paralog; require split-aware phylogeny/RBH against other Src paralogs.
LYN.label: LYN

LCK.classification_note: LCK Src paralog; require split-aware phylogeny/RBH against other Src paralogs.
LCK.label: LCK

HCK.classification_note: HCK Src paralog; require split-aware phylogeny/RBH against other Src paralogs.
HCK.label: HCK

BLK.classification_note: BLK Src paralog; require split-aware phylogeny/RBH against other Src paralogs.
BLK.label: BLK

FGR.classification_note: FGR Src paralog; require split-aware phylogeny/RBH against other Src paralogs.
FGR.label: FGR

Csk_family.classification_note: CSK/MATK share SH3-SH2-kinase order with Src. Family-specific profile/phylogenetic evidence required.
Csk_family.label: Csk_family

CSK.classification_note: CSK subfamily: do not infer from the domain architecture or Csk/Chk motif alone.
CSK.label: CSK

MATK.classification_note: MATK subfamily: do not infer from the domain architecture or Csk/Chk motif alone.
MATK.label: MATK

Abl_family.classification_note: Abl-family kinases often contain C-terminal extended actin-binding region (may be missing from isoforms/fragments); resolve from the competing SH3-SH2-TK families by phylogeny.
Abl_family.label: Abl_family

ABL1.classification_note: ABL1; ABL1 versus ABL2 requires paralog resolution, not kinase-core architecture.
ABL1.label: ABL1

ABL2.classification_note: ABL2; ABL1 versus ABL2 requires paralog resolution, not kinase-core architecture.
ABL2.label: ABL2

Tec_family.classification_note: Tec-family kinases typically PH/TH-SH3-SH2-kinase. TXK is exceptional: its N-terminal region lacks PH-TH. Family identity requires competing profile/phylogeny.
Tec_family.label: Tec_family

BTK.classification_note: BTK Tec family; TXK lacks PH-TH and requires non-architecture subfamily evidence. PH domain is not unique to Tec kinases.
BTK.label: BTK

TEC.classification_note: TEC Tec family; TXK lacks PH-TH and requires non-architecture subfamily evidence. PH domain is not unique to Tec kinases.
TEC.label: TEC

ITK.classification_note: ITK Tec family; TXK lacks PH-TH and requires non-architecture subfamily evidence. PH domain is not unique to Tec kinases.
ITK.label: ITK

BMX.classification_note: BMX Tec family; TXK lacks PH-TH and requires non-architecture subfamily evidence. PH domain is not unique to Tec kinases.
BMX.label: BMX

TXK.classification_note: TXK Tec family; TXK lacks PH-TH and requires non-architecture subfamily evidence. PH domain is not unique to Tec kinases.
TXK.label: TXK

FRK_PTK6_SRMS_family.classification_note: FRK/PTK6/SRMS are essential outgroups for Src/Csk/ABL/Tec competitions.
FRK_PTK6_SRMS_family.label: FRK_PTK6_SRMS_family

FRK.classification_note: FRK, negative competitor for conventional Src family.
FRK.label: FRK

PTK6.classification_note: PTK6, negative competitor for conventional Src family.
PTK6.label: PTK6

SRMS.classification_note: SRMS, negative competitor for conventional Src family.
SRMS.label: SRMS

SYK.classification_note: Syk rather than ZAP70 requires phylogenetic support.
SYK.label: SYK

ZAP70.classification_note: ZAP70 rather than Syk requires phylogenetic support.
ZAP70.label: ZAP70

screening_notes: Expected architectures and lengths describe reference-like proteins, not universal metazoan requirements. Comparative mode retains incomplete architectures and generic-domain candidates without assigning family identity. Screening anchors are recruitment evidence, not necessarily family-specific domains.
